title: Component Variables
summary: Official Derivative reference for component variables, covering local component scope, hierarchical lookup, Python var() reads, Tscript cvar/rvar behavior, and the internal local/variables and local/set_variables DAT storage pattern.
guidance: Use this article when a legacy network or Tscript-era component depends on component variables rather than Python extensions or custom parameters.
Prefer Extensions or custom parameters for new Python-heavy components because official docs call extension properties more flexible in Python.
Use var('VARNAME') to fetch a component variable in Python expressions.
Remember variable lookup climbs parent components until the variable is found or the root is reached.
Treat local/variables and local/set_variables as implementation details unless maintaining a network that already uses them.
